stories.title: India hits 20% ethanol blending milestone
stories.summary: India reached its 20% ethanol blending target for the 2025-26 marketing year, according to industry body AIDA. Grain-based feedstock accounted for 74% of the total supply. The milestone marks the conclusion of the government's current blending push.

stories.title: India targets $1 trillion in exports this year
stories.summary: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India aims for $1 trillion in goods and services exports this financial year. The country recorded $480 billion in the first six months, which the minister described as a tremendous success despite what he called troubled times.

stories.title: India needs $430 billion in exports to meet target
stories.summary: India requires $430 billion in goods and services exports between November and March to reach its $1 trillion goal for 2026-27. The country had achieved 57% of the target by the end of October. The math leaves five months to cover the remaining 43%.

stories.title: Modi rebukes industry over lack of innovation
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi questioned why domestic businesses have failed to innovate or boost employment despite government tax cuts and ease-of-doing-business reforms. Addressing the FICCI convention, the Prime Minister noted that industry had yet to deliver a reciprocal benefit to the economy.

stories.title: Modi tells industry not to take Indian market for granted
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi warned industry leaders against assuming that India’s 140 crore people will always serve as an assured market. He questioned the industry's progress over the last century and suggested that relying on domestic consumption to absorb any product is a potential problem.

stories.title: Manufacturing share in GDP must hit 25% by 2047
stories.summary: S Mahendra Dev, chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister, said India must raise manufacturing's share of GDP to 25% by 2047 to become a developed economy. Achieving this status requires sustained 8% annual real GDP growth over the next 21 years.

stories.title: US and India seek fair trade partnership
stories.summary: The US-India relationship is at a historic high point, according to US diplomat Jason Meeks. Both nations are working to build a trade partnership described as fair, reciprocal, and mutually beneficial, with cooperation expanding into energy, pharmaceuticals, and critical minerals.

stories.title: PM Modi asks industry to suggest further reforms
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged India Inc to suggest reforms needed to accelerate growth without hesitation. Addressing the FICCI convention, he also encouraged corporates to focus on self-reliance and invest heavily in agriculture, citing the rapid pace at which the country is moving out of poverty.

stories.title: Finance ministry official calls for higher wages
stories.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur urged Indian firms to boost wages to support consumer demand. While noting that private investment is gaining momentum, the ministry official pointed to the stagnation of wages as a factor squeezing household purchasing power.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty rally on strong buying
stories.summary: Domestic stock markets saw strong buying interest on Thursday, with the Sensex and Nifty 50 recovering from early weakness to close higher. The rally added Rs 4.36 lakh crore to investor wealth, driven by heavy buying in automobile, banking, and consumer sectors.

stories.title: Indian stocks buck Asian selloff
stories.summary: Indian shares rose on Thursday, led by auto and financial stocks, as falling commodity prices and foreign buying outweighed losses in IT. The Nifty 50 gained 1.14% to 25,514, while the Sensex rose 1.21% to 83,021. Fifteen of 16 major sectors advanced.

stories.title: Foreign inflows drive market recovery
stories.summary: Indian stock markets recovered from a flat start to close more than 1% higher on Thursday. Sustained foreign investor inflows and easing commodity prices supported the rally, with the Nifty 50 closing at 25,514 and the Sensex ending at 83,021.

stories.title: Bank Nifty hits record high
stories.summary: The Nifty Bank index closed above 63,000 for the first time on Thursday, while the Sensex reclaimed the 83,000 level. Both benchmarks reached their highest closing levels in nine months, supported by buying across lenders and auto stocks.

stories.title: Bulls lead broad market rally
stories.summary: Benchmark indices extended gains on Thursday as auto stocks led a broad-based rally. The Sensex rebounded more than 1,176 points from its intraday low, while the Nifty 50 moved toward the 25,500 mark. The recovery followed a weak start to the trading session.

stories.title: Market adds Rs 6 lakh crore in value
stories.summary: The Sensex jumped 990 points to 83,022 and the Nifty 50 reclaimed 25,500 on Thursday. The gains added nearly Rs 6 lakh crore to the total market capitalization of NSE-listed companies. IT stocks bucked the trend, leading losses on the benchmark index.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty gain in afternoon trade
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices rose on Thursday, supported by buying in auto and consumer durable stocks. Bharat Forge shares climbed 2.7% following a rights issue investment. The volatility gauge, India VIX, surged 6.3% to an intraday high of 16.50.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty trade higher
stories.summary: The Sensex rose 422 points and the Nifty 50 gained 127 points by midday on Thursday. Investors assessed mixed global cues while auto and PSU bank stocks led the gains. Broader markets, including the Nifty MidCap 100, also advanced.

stories.title: LT Foods acquires Maya Kaimal Foods
stories.summary: LT Foods Americas has acquired Maya Kaimal Foods. The deal combines the company's Royal basmati rice brand with Maya Kaimal's line of Indian sauces and dals, expanding the firm's footprint in the United States consumer food market.

Brookfield nears $1.7-billion deal to buy packaging firm PGP Glass from Blackstone - Moneycontrol.com
Voltas and Atomberg form joint venture for AC compressors
stories.summary: Voltas and Atomberg Innovation have finalized a 50:50 joint venture to manufacture room air conditioner compressors in India. Each partner has committed up to ₹100 crore in capital investment for the new entity, Atomberg Airtech. The companies aim to coordinate production through the shared venture.

stories.title: Paytm to acquire 19.1% stake in CardUp
stories.summary: Paytm Singapore plans to invest approximately ₹162 crore to acquire a 19.1% stake in CardUp, a payments subsidiary of Funding Societies. The deal is part of a strategy to expand internationally while limiting capital deployment. The acquisition is expected to be completed by May 20, 2027.

stories.title: KKR Invests in India Renewables Business Run by Petronas-Backed Gentari - WSJ
Fidel Softech to acquire IT services firm Softenger
stories.summary: Fidel Softech has initiated the acquisition of Softenger, an IT infrastructure and cybersecurity company with ₹200 crore in revenue. The move is intended to expand Fidel's geographical reach across Asia and increase its pool of IT professionals. Softenger currently operates in India, Singapore, Malaysia and the UAE.

stories.title: Aster DM in talks for $150 million hospital acquisition
stories.summary: Blackstone-backed Aster DM Quality Care is negotiating the purchase of hospitals in northern India from Narayana Hrudayalaya. The deal could be worth up to $150 million. Blackstone, which owns 30% of Aster, recently listed the company as one of its 10 largest global investments.

stories.title: APL Apollo Tubes promoter family explores stake sale, deal size could top Rs 32,000 crore with open offer - Moneycontrol
Respiratory illness claims rise as air quality worsens
stories.summary: Respiratory illnesses accounted for 58% of hospitalisation claims for children and senior citizens in FY26, according to Care Health Insurance. As air quality fluctuates across India, the insurer has issued a public health advisory urging preventive measures. Delhi's air quality recently reached a seasonal peak of 428.

stories.title: A guide to analysing mutual funds
stories.summary: Financial experts suggest that investors should look beyond recent returns and star ratings when choosing mutual funds. Recommended checks include evaluating expense ratios, portfolio quality, and consistency across market cycles. Beginners are advised to define their investment purpose and timeline before comparing schemes to avoid common pitfalls.

stories.title: Pensioners seek higher minimum monthly payouts
stories.summary: The Bharat Pensioners Samaj has proposed raising the minimum monthly pension to ₹45,000 under the 8th Pay Commission. The proposal also suggests increasing pension rates from 50% to 67% of the last pay drawn. Previous commissions have rejected similar requests, citing the impact of successive pay revisions.

stories.title: EPFO approves systematic withdrawal plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Central Board of Trustees has approved a systematic withdrawal plan for EPFO subscribers. The voluntary facility will allow retirees to receive their provident fund savings in monthly, quarterly or half-yearly instalments. The remaining corpus will continue to earn returns while held by the fund.

stories.title: India biodiesel blending remains at 0.08%
stories.summary: India's biodiesel blending level reached 0.18% in FY26, falling significantly short of the 5% target set for 2030. Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited cited limited raw material availability as the primary constraint. Public sector oil marketing companies sold approximately 4,900 crore litres of fuel during the period.

stories.title: Debate intensifies over potential LTCG tax cuts
stories.summary: Investors and industry leaders are lobbying for a reduction in Long-Term Capital Gains tax to attract foreign capital. Economists remain in favour of retaining the current structure as equity taxes become a significant revenue source. The government faces a choice between tax relief and the status quo.

stories.title: PFRDA considers higher commissions for NPS distributors
stories.summary: PFRDA chairman S. Ramann says the regulator is exploring ways to improve distributor incentives for the National Pension System. Current commissions remain about a fifth of those offered in the mutual fund industry. The move aims to expand the scheme's reach beyond government employees.

stories.title: MK Jewels marks IPO milestone with continued customer engagement campaign - The Retail Jeweller India
Tax rules for stocks, mutual funds and gold ETFs
stories.summary: As the Union Budget 2027 approaches, market participants are debating the roles of Long-Term Capital Gains tax and Securities Transaction Tax. While LTCG applies to profits after a holding period, STT is charged on all eligible buy and sell transactions on stock exchanges regardless of profit or loss.
